fromAgent.description: Slug of the agent that passed the baton.

artifactId.description: Artifact that motivated the handoff (product_brief, module_map…).

status.description: This field is MUTABLE — it is the current state. Each transition also becomes an immutable `handoff.*` event in the log, which is where the history lives. `superseded` (ADR 0182, RN-635): the offer stopped being the current one — the target agent was activated by another path, or a newer offer to the same target in the project replaced it (`handoff.superseded`). Only `offered` can be accepted.

desfecho.description: `criado`: a new offer. `substituiu_oferta`: a new offer, and the pending one(s) to the same target became `superseded`. `ja_oferecido`: no new row — the pending offer already there is returned (same session and no new artifact, or `seAusente`).

cobertas.description: Rules cited by at least one story — equal to `regras`.

repositorio.description: `local`: the project already had a `local` repository. `a_provisionar_local`: none yet — the accept provisions a `local` one.

motivo.description: Why a person still has to click. `falhou`: the system tried and the accept failed — `handoff.auto_accept_failed` is in the event log.

403.description: Service token missing or different from the shared one.

404.description: Session, project, or resource not found.

409.description: `agente_ja_ativo` (ADR 0182, RN-635): the target is already active in a non-closed session of the project. The `message` is the text the agent reads as the tool result.
